_help: Hand-edited. extra_dem / extra_gop add names Wikipedia doesn't list; exclude drops names; search_names gives alternate spellings for the news query (also used to spot the candidate in headlines); va_terms are the Virginia places/figures a headline must name to count as VA coverage. Kaine/Warner are left out on purpose: they co-sign Senate letters with half the field.

extra_dem.name: Cory Booker
extra_dem.bio: Cory Booker has served as a U.S. senator from New Jersey since 2013.

_right_media_help: Right-leaning national outlets. Case-insensitive substring match on the Google News source name (which is sometimes a domain, hence both spellings). Tags stories for the R-media % column; nothing is filtered out. Local Fox affiliates ('FOX 5 DC') don't match on purpose.
